verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents a hosted feedback portal with voting and a public roadmap, which implies a page developers can link to from their product. Standalone, custom-domain pages are documented for changelogs. No evidence specifically covers linking users from a product into the feedback portal. Missing for 10: explicit docs on the portal URL or custom domain for linking, guidance on in-product links or deep links (e.g., auto-authenticated or SSO links into the portal), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
